summary: Iteration 29 — per-day profit + per-line invoice cost + monthly portfolio: PASS. Backend pytest 12/12 PASSED (test_iteration29_profit_reports.py) against public URL https://open-my-project-10.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Verified: (1) POST /api/invoices persists per-item unit_cost + cost_amount and invoice-level cost_total + profit=total-cost_total (2×500 rate + 1×200 rate with 300/80 costs → total=1200, cost_total=680, profit=520); (2) PUT /api/invoices/{id} recomputes cost_total+profit on admin edit; (3) invoices without unit_cost default to cost=0 and profit=total; (4) unit_cost<0 rejected with 400; (5) GET /api/stats/pnl returns combined revenue/cogs from sales+invoices with sales_count/invoice_count/expense_count, invariants gross=rev-cogs and net=gross-exp both hold; employee gets 403; (6) GET /api/stats/profit-daily?days=30 returns rows sorted newest-first with all profit fields + totals, employee 403; (7) GET /api/stats/profit-monthly?months=12 returns YYYY-MM keyed rows newest-first, accepts months=36 for backward browsing, employee 403; (8) GET /api/reports/pnl.xlsx returns valid xlsx (PK header) with header containing 'Invoices','Sales','Revenue','Net profit' columns. Frontend UI verified (mobile viewport 390×844): Reports screen (admin) shows P&L card (Net profit ₹24,500, Revenue ₹30,500 with '3 sales · 3 invoices' subline, COGS ₹6,000, Gross profit ₹24,500, Expenses ₹0), 'PER-DAY PROFIT · LAST 30 DAYS' list with day row (6 Sep · Rev/Cost/Exp breakdown · net right-aligned), 'MONTHLY PROFIT & EXPENSE' portfolio with Sep 2026 card showing Revenue/Product cost/Expenses tiles and '3 sales · 3 invoices · 0 expenses' subline. Load-more-months button correctly hidden when only 1 month exists. Invoice form: New invoice modal shows Cost (₹) input per product line (testID inv-item-cost-0), live Amount + Profit per line (₹1,000 amt / ₹400 profit for qty=2 rate=500 cost=300), and Total cost (₹600) + Profit (₹400) summary tiles under Grand total ₹1,000. All existing warnings (expo-notifications web, Image resizeMode deprecated, pointerEvents) are cosmetic and carried over from prior iterations — no new regressions.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4461 lines — still exceeds the <700 lines/module guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, customers, sales, invoices, receipts, daybook, stats, exports, admin) at a future refactor sprint. Carried over from prior iterations.

server.py:4125-4227 — three P&L endpoints duplicate the same $match+$group aggregation shape (sales excluding source='invoice', invoices, expenses). Consider extracting a helper _agg_profit(match_stage, group_stage) to DRY the ~30 lines duplicated across pnl / profit-daily / profit-monthly / reports/pnl.xlsx.

server.py:4204-4227 — profit-monthly aggregates ALL history (no since filter) then slices to `months` after sort; fine for small datasets, but could grow O(N) with time. Consider using date_key regex match on `^YYYY-MM` for the earliest month in the window to bound scan.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Reports screen sections + Invoice form Cost/Profit UI all rendered correctly)
